The structure of Na₂Ag (Na₈Ag₄ per cell) crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with 12 atoms distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows each Ag center has 8 Na neighbors and each Na center has 4 Ag neighbors, both forming body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements with a uniform neighbor distance of 3.096 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner, edge, and face sharing between adjacent Na-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Ag- and Na-centered polyhedra.
